rules.description: Every PageSpec must contain exactly one node whose section id starts with 'hero.'.
rules.exception: None -- every one of the 9 real templates has exactly one hero.* node (verified against templates/templates.json's own node lists: hero.home, hero.about, hero.contact-form, hero.integrations, hero.blog-index, hero.blog-post, hero.case-study, hero.legal, hero.not-found). There is no hero-less template in this design-repo.

rules.description: shell.navbar must be the first non-announcement-bar node; shell.footer must be the second-to-last node; shell.cookie-banner must be the last node.
When cta.join-the-wave or cta.closing is present, it must be the node immediately before shell.footer.
content.article-body must be immediately followed by cta.customer-intelligence.
rules.exception: None -- verified directly: src/pages/BlogPost.jsx:44-45 and src/pages/CaseStudy.jsx:79-80 both render <Article/> then <CiCta/> with nothing between.

rules.description: hero.home, proof.logo-strip, features.platform-grid, features.product-overview, proof.enterprise-scale, proof.testimonials, faq.integrations-promo, and cta.closing may only appear on template.home.

hero.blog-post + faq.blog-post are restricted to template.blog-post; hero.case-study + content.related-case-studies are restricted to template.case-study; hero.legal + content.legal-prose are restricted to template.legal; hero.not-found is restricted to template.not-found.
Two hero.* nodes must never be adjacent (redundant with ONE_HERO_PER_PAGE today, kept as a defense-in-depth warn rule in case a future template legitimately needs two non-adjacent heroes).
Every node with a non-'none' motion.pattern must declare motion.reducedMotionFallback from the closed enum (static-final-state | first-frame-static).

Every href-bearing field anywhere in a PageSpec (ctaHref, linkHref, footer column hrefs, etc.) must be same-site: it must start with '/' or '#'. This mirrors src/components/ui.jsx's localHref/isInternal, which structurally refuses to render any other href.
rules.exception: None -- this is a real, load-bearing product constraint (all outbound links were deliberately stripped this session), not a style preference.
